notes: Intent-level taxonomy. Categories describe the task the user wanted done, not the specific fandom or template. est_minutes_manual = rough time a person would need without AI (assumption, used for ROI); null = no business value to count.

categories.name: Coding & software development
categories.description: Writing, debugging, explaining or reviewing code in any language, including SQL, spreadsheet formulas and scripts.
categories.includes: error messages and tracebacks, 'write a function that…', code review, regex, SQL queries, Excel/Sheets formulas, build/install errors
categories.excludes: general questions about hardware or software products with no code (-> IT & tech support)

categories.name: IT & tech support
categories.description: Questions about hardware, software, networks, devices and how to set up or troubleshoot them, without writing code.
categories.includes: PC/phone problems, choosing hardware, networking, software features, how something technical works
categories.excludes: requests to write or fix code (-> Coding)

categories.name: Business, finance & strategy
categories.description: Business plans, financial statements, pricing, markets, economics and strategic decisions.
categories.includes: income statements, budgets, loans, market analysis, business plans, economics homework
categories.excludes: writing an email or letter about a business topic (-> Business communication)

categories.name: Business communication
categories.description: Drafting or polishing emails, formal letters and short workplace messages.
categories.includes: client emails, follow-ups, complaints, apologies, announcements, polishing a message the user wrote
categories.excludes: long articles or essays (-> Long-form writing & editing)

categories.name: Marketing, SEO & product copy
categories.description: Copy meant to sell or promote: product listings, SEO titles and keywords, ads, social posts.
categories.includes: Etsy/Amazon listings, SEO keywords, product descriptions, ad copy, social media captions
categories.excludes: long blog posts or e-book chapters (-> Long-form writing & editing)

categories.name: Long-form writing & editing
categories.description: Non-fiction long-form text: essays, articles, blog posts, e-book chapters, and rewriting or proofreading text.
categories.includes: essays, articles, blog posts, guide or e-book chapters, 'rewrite/expand/proofread this'
categories.excludes: fiction, scripts and role-play (-> Creative writing & role-play)

categories.name: Translation & languages
categories.description: Translating text between languages and questions about language use.
categories.includes: translate this, grammar and vocabulary questions, 'how do you say…'
categories.excludes: proofreading in the same language (-> Long-form writing & editing)

categories.name: Careers & HR
categories.description: CVs, cover letters, job applications, interviews, performance reviews and people management.
categories.includes: CV/LinkedIn writing, cover letters, interview prep, performance reviews, team or project management
categories.excludes: general business strategy (-> Business, finance & strategy)

categories.name: Science, health & learning
categories.description: Factual questions and study help in science, medicine, biology, chemistry and other academic subjects.
categories.includes: biology/chemistry/medical questions, lab reports, explaining a scientific concept, exam questions
categories.excludes: fictional history or invented worlds (-> Creative writing & role-play)

categories.name: Image generation prompts
categories.description: Writing prompts for image generators (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion) and visual style descriptions.
categories.includes: the pasted 'As a prompt generator for Midjourney…' template, lists of image prompts, art-style descriptions
categories.excludes: writing code for graphics such as SVG or CSS (-> Coding)

categories.name: Creative writing & role-play
categories.description: Fiction of any kind: stories, scripts, fan fiction, parodies, crossovers, invented worlds and interactive role-play.
categories.includes: 'write a story/script about…', TV or sports scripts, fan fiction, parodies, character crossovers, worldbuilding, role-play scenarios
categories.excludes: real-world factual questions (-> the matching topic); jailbreak or persona setups (-> Jailbreak & persona prompts)

categories.name: Jailbreak & persona prompts
categories.description: Attempts to bypass the assistant's rules (DAN, Developer Mode) and 'act as' persona setups, plus questions about the model itself.
categories.includes: DAN, Developer Mode, 'ignore previous instructions', 'are you GPT-4?', persona setups
categories.excludes: ordinary 'act as a translator/teacher' requests that then do a normal task (-> that task)

categories.name: Chit-chat & other
categories.description: Greetings, small talk, jokes, riddles, tests and requests too short or unclear to classify.
categories.includes: 'hi', 'who are you', jokes, riddles, one-word messages, unclear requests
categories.excludes: anything with a clear task (-> that task)
